checks.source: retire.js jsrepository-v4.json (GitHub/NVD advisories), reviewed 2026-11-02 against NVD and the project repository; CVE-2020-27511 (reported against 1.7.3, the last release, 2015; no commit since 2017); OWASP Top 10 A06 (unsupported components)
checks.applicability: Applies to pages on which the library is detected: its window global (with its version field) or, for jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Lodash and Handlebars, a script URL whose path names the library and a version.
checks.expectation: Fails for every detected Prototype version: unmaintained, and every release is covered by CVE-2020-27511. There is no conforming version; the negative is a look-alike: an application class named Prototype without the library's `Prototype.Version` is not the library. A page without the library: not applicable. A page that breaks the detection scripts (result missing or malformed) is not run for every library, never clean.
